levels.title: Breach Point
levels.briefing: You are inside the perimeter. Seize the elevator keycard from the garrison floor and reach extraction before a lockdown starts.
levels.win_condition: Objective: secure the keycard and activate extraction

levels.title: Machine Hall
levels.briefing: The stolen keycard grants access to the refinery wing. Disable all three control consoles to crash the production line and force command to respond.
levels.win_condition: Objective: disable every refinery control console

levels.title: Command Vault
levels.briefing: With the refinery dark, command is isolated. Eliminate the commander in the vault, then transmit the beacon to guide allied extraction.
levels.win_condition: Objective: eliminate the commander and activate the beacon
